en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 5. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ali Majluwayh from his uncle Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim from Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad b. Sinan from Hamad b. Uthman from Khalaf b. Hamad from Rib’i from al-Fudhayl b. Yasar from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
When some people of a community start disobeying Allah, they will be the army of Iblees whether they ride or walk.”
